set.pl: Knaggs' trading post site: N. G. Phillips's 44 acres on the Shiawassee at the 1875 road crossing, N sec. 6 Burns Twp T5N R4E, Shiawassee Co
pinev: N. G. Phillips 44 ac on the river at the 1875 road crossing, N sec 6 Burns Twp (post site per MPHC 1902).

On the USGS 3DEP 10 m DEM the only road crossing of the river in N sec 6 is where roads from the W and E meet the valley near 42.8613,-84.0322; the earlier Cole Rd east-bank gullies pin (42.8615,-84.0295) lies about 220 m E of it, so they are the same crossing and the 300 m ring covers both banks.
set.tovw: Lead grade B (treasure thread): 1902 county-society account and 1936-37 articles agree on digs at the post site; site fixed from the 1875 plat
set.t: The 1902 Pioneer Collections telling predates the 1936-37 articles and names the landowner (N. G. Phillips), whose 1875 tract fixes the post site at the old road crossing.

src: Atlas of Shiawassee County (1875), Burns T5N R4E
